Pin and sign every capsule under a folder

Source: R/capsule_check.R
cpsseal.Rd

Seals each capsule (a folder holding data_provenance.json) under path, so that a program in any language only has to write the data file and a plain provenance naming it ({"resource": {"filename": "data.csv"}}): on its first run the provenance is pinned to the data file's bytes as cpsrfrsh pins it (resource$sha256, size_bytes, retrieved_utc, the row count when one is recorded), then cpsbndl signs every file of the capsule into capsule_bundle.json, over its manifest.json when it has one. rmbl sign calls it and then verifies (cpschk).

Usage

cpsseal(path = ".", key, overwrite = FALSE, glob = "")

Arguments

path

Character scalar, the folder searched recursively.

key

The signing key, as cpsbndl() takes it: a shared secret (a string or raw vector) for an "hmac" bundle, or a key from fipskg or fipskey, or an XMSS key from pqckg, which signs one capsule after another at consecutive indices (each reserved as cpssign reserves it).

overwrite

Logical: sign a capsule that already has a bundle again.

glob

Character scalar: only the provenance files whose path matches this glob (* also matches /), or "".

Value

A data frame, one row per capsule: capsule, pinned (whether the provenance was pinned now), files (the number signed) and public (the HMAC key id or the public key; never the secret).

Details

A provenance already pinned (one with resource$sha256) is left as it is. Side effects: writes data_provenance.json (first run) and capsule_bundle.json in each capsule. Errors, before anything is written: no provenance under path; a capsule that already has a bundle, unless overwrite; then, per capsule, a resource$filename that is not a plain relative path to a file in the capsule, and the refusals of cpsbndl() (a key it cannot sign with).

See also

cpsbndl, cpschk, blcli (rmbl sign).

Examples

root <- tempfile("capsules-")
d <- file.path(root, "one")
dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE)
utils::write.csv(data.frame(x = 1:3), file.path(d, "data.csv"),
                 row.names = FALSE)
writeLines('{"resource": {"filename": "data.csv"}}',
           file.path(d, "data_provenance.json"))
s <- cpsseal(root, "a shared secret")
s
#>                                     capsule pinned files
#> 1 /tmp/Rtmp8mkWXN/capsules-219752999025/one   TRUE     2
#>                                                             public
#> 1 2b23046c08926e30017362694e61c9f76f64815699749bede71734e74c84f65e
cpschk(root, key = "a shared secret", fp = FALSE)$status
#> [1] "ok"

# a second run needs overwrite, and a post-quantum key signs too
try(cpsseal(root, "a shared secret"))
#> Error : cpsseal: capsule_bundle.json already exists in /tmp/Rtmp8mkWXN/capsules-219752999025/one; pass overwrite = TRUE (rmbl sign --overwrite) to sign again
cpsseal(root, fipskg("ML-DSA-44"), overwrite = TRUE)$pinned
#> [1] FALSE
